BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, and it is death: Saul was consenting unto the death of Stephen, and at that time there was a great persecution against the church at Jerusalem. It is the noun for the killing itself — the act Stephen's death is named by, in the verse where the scattering of the church begins.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a killing carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the verse — Stephen's death, Saul consenting, and the church scattered abroad by the persecution that followed.
